mapper.select: SELECT article_id, author_id, title, summary, cover, status, visibility, publish_time, revise_time, create_time, update_time FROM articles WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND

SELECT article_id, author_id, title, summary, cover, status, visibility, publish_time, revise_time, create_time, update_time FROM articles WHERE AND article_id IN
#{articleId}

SELECT article_id, author_id, title, summary, cover, status, visibility, publish_time, revise_time, create_time, update_time FROM articles WHERE AND title ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT article_id, author_id, title, summary, cover, status, visibility, publish_time, revise_time, create_time, update_time FROM articles WHERE ORDER BY publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles a JOIN article_tags t ON t.article_id = a.article_id WHERE a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND t.tag_id = #{tagId}
